create_graph_network: create a GraphNetwork module with configurable edge, node, and global blocks for general-purpose graph processing
create_interaction_network: create an InteractionNetwork that updates edges from node-edge interactions and then updates nodes from incoming edges
create_relation_network: create a RelationNetwork that computes global properties from pairwise relations between nodes
create_self_attention: create a multi-head self-attention module that aggregates sender node values for each receiver node using attention weights
create_deep_sets: create a DeepSets module that updates nodes and aggregates them into global features for set-based graph processing
